# bitbucket_project_group_permission (Resource)

Grants a workspace group a permission level (read/write/admin) on a Bitbucket Cloud project, applying to every repository inside it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_project_group_permission" "release_managers" {
  project_key = bitbucket_project.platform.key
  group_slug  = "release-managers"
  permission  = "write"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_slug` (String) Slug of the workspace group to grant access to.
- `permission` (String) Permission level: "read", "write" or "admin".
- `project_key` (String) Key of the project to grant access to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/project_key/group_slug".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_project_group_permission.release_managers PLAT/release-managers
```
